title: Prism Identity Cutover - Conflicting Closure Records

summary.text: The identity cutover has conflicting closure records, so its overall outcome remains unresolved.

evidence.quote: The release summary states: "All 240 accounts migrated successfully and no sign-in failures remained." A separate reconciliation note for the same cutover states: "Only 228 accounts were verified; 12 account owners still could not sign in." Both refer to the same workgroup and closure window. No later authoritative correction is present. The overall outcome is unresolved.
